findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded credentials
 * @description Hardcoded passwords, tokens, or API keys in source code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python

from StrConst str
where
  (
    str.getText().regexpMatch("(?i).*(password|passwd|pwd|secret|token|api_key|apikey).*") and
    str.getText().length() > 8 and
    not str.getText().regexpMatch("(?i).*(test|example|sample|demo|placeholder|your_|my_|<|>|\\{|\\}).*")
  ) or
  (
    str.getText().regexpMatch("[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}") and
    not str.getText().regexpMatch("^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$")
  )
select str, "Potential hardcoded credential found: " + str.getText().prefix(50)
findings.hypothesis: Check for hardcoded credentials, API keys, or secrets in the source code

message.text: Potential hardcoded credential found: api_key and credentials_file are mutually exclusiv

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular expression injection
 * @description Using user input in regular expressions can lead to ReDoS attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/regex-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "search", "match", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn", "split"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Regular expression operation that may be vulnerable to ReDoS if pattern is user-controlled"
findings.hypothesis: Check for regular expression operations that could be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks
